alleys.note: 15' alley between Halstead and McMicken, McMillan to Eliza; continues straight across Eliza (next segment)
same 15' alley, Eliza to Dixon, ends at Dixon (no continuation south of Dixon)

bends.note: Addison's south end turns a right angle west into an unnamed 40' street running to the canal bank (L corner; Addison does not continue south)

ends.note: west end of Addison's 40' westward leg at the Miami Canal bank; a narrow (~11') footbridge crosses the canal at y~3305-3370 (not a street)
west end at the Miami Canal bank; a narrow (~11') footbridge continues across the canal to Colerain Avenue (not a street)
north dead end of the unnamed ~20' street running north from Warner (the 236 '?' street): stops at a lot line

notes: Names printed without a suffix (HALSTEAD, ADDISON, ELIZA, DIXON, WARNER) are written with 'Street'. W. McMillan: only its south line is on the paper (y~258-262); the 40' width puts its centre at y~140, still on the paper (paper top ~y 70). McMillan meets McMicken from the west only: McMicken's east line is unbroken up to the paper top, so McMillan east of McMicken (onto 249) must sit further north, off this sheet; recorded as T. Halstead (50') runs straight from McMillan (assumed to continue north onto 256 toward Klottman, so cross) to Dixon and ends there; south of Dixon its line is carried on by Bush Alley (20'), whose centre is ~190 px east of Halstead's, so two T points on Dixon. Two different unnamed streets are both written '?': (1) a 20' street (lines y~1455/1577) from Addison's north end east to Halstead, forming an L corner with Addison (Addison ends there; recorded as T at Addison and T at Halstead); (2) a ~20' street running north from Warner (lines x~4662/4790 at Warner) to a dead end at y 4633, which is the '?' street that sheet 236 records Ting into Warner. Addison (40') is L-shaped: north end at the 20' '?' street, south end turning west as an unnamed 40' leg to the canal (bend + end). Warner is 40' west of the '?' street and 50' east of it (north line steps from y~7047 to ~6988); centre taken at y~7155 there. Eliza is 40' and ends at Halstead and at McMicken (T both). Dixon is 40' and ends at McMicken (T). Dashed double lines are water pipes. The dash-dot vertical line lettered C/D at x~6200 is a boundary line, not a street. Colerain Avenue is at the left edge across the canal, with no junctions on this sheet.
